name: Murna of the White Neck
text: Murna of the White Neck is the anglicized rendering of Muirenn Muncháem, whose name draws on words for the back of the neck and for fairness. She bore the hero Fionn mac Cumhaill.

attributes.attribute: English form built on the sense fair-necked

sources: MacKillop 2008, s.v. 'Murna of the White Neck'

okr.objective: Documents Murna of the White Neck as recorded in MacKillop 2008 for the Public Celtic Encyclopedia.
key_results: Murna of the White Neck renders Muirenn Muncháem in English.
The name belongs to the mother of Fionn mac Cumhaill.
